message.response: Fix the unresolved key reference in the source DITA content; a graph built on an unresolved reference would be silently wrong.
The lower-confidence edge was dropped rather than guessed. Review the source content if a specific relationship was expected.

message.reason: Topic skipped because status="draft" and include-drafts is false.
message.response: Set --args.dita2graph.include-drafts=true to include draft topics in the graph.

message.reason: Generated OKF concept failed okf-validator conformance.
message.response: See the validation report for the specific issue; the build fails before the bundle is considered complete.

message.reason: Topic has no resolvable type mapping (unknown/custom topic type).
message.response: Emitted as a generic OKF concept. Review whether the topic type should be added to the mapping table (section 4.1).

message.reason: A copy DITA-OT writes under another name (copy-to, or branch filtering with a ditavalref resource prefix or suffix) carries the same id as its source topic.
message.response: No action needed: the source keeps its id and the copy's graph node gets a suffixed one, linked to the source by copy-of and generated-from.

message.reason: Elements other topics reuse have no @id: the graph names their fragments element@line, a name that changes as soon as a line is added above them.
message.response: Give each reused element of the file an @id, so its fragment name (and its IRI in the RDF export) stays stable.

message.reason: The source file of a topic could not be read on its own to find its coderef and conkeyref elements, which preprocessing removes.
message.response: No action needed for the build: the topic keeps every other relation. Its includes-code and conkeyref key uses are missing from the graph; a source that needs its DTD to parse (an entity it defines) is the usual cause.

message.reason: A <navref> map-composition element was found but is not resolved by DITA-OT for this transtype and is not independently parsed by this plugin.
message.response: The referenced navigation map's content is excluded from the graph. Restructure the source to use topicref/mapref instead if that content should appear.

message.reason: The RDF export breaks a rule of the d2g SHACL shapes whose severity is Violation (a loop in the table of contents, a used key no map defines...).
message.response: The build fails. Fix the source the message points at; docs/semantic-model.md lists the shapes and their rules.

message.reason: The RDF export breaks a rule of the d2g SHACL shapes whose severity is Warning, such as a published topic without a parent in the table of contents.
message.response: No action needed for the build. Each case is worth a look: a topic merged into its parent by chunk="to-content" is a common cause.

message.reason: The RDF export breaks a rule of the d2g SHACL shapes whose severity is Info.
The RDF export has no base IRI: its node IRIs use the placeholder https://dita2graph.invalid/<map id>/.
message.response: Set --args.dita2graph.rdf.base to a namespace you control before publishing rdf/graph.ttl or loading it next to other graphs.
